answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds lock staking collateral into a kernel of time-weighted deposits, forcing any Sybil identity to forfeit the present value of forgone yields. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix calibrates penalties proportional to the verifiable delay proved by zero-knowledge proofs, rendering the expected attack utility strictly negative for any rational adversary. The resulting game exhibits a hollow outcome where even a falcon coordinated coalition cannot improve payoff, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium resistant to identity multiplication.
